opening.argument: The speaker opens by saying the video will analyze a tweet, and the supplied frame shows that tweet discussing an alleged dark-web live stream connected to the Sushant Singh Rajput case. The live-stream claim is presented as part of that discussion, not as an invitation from the creator to join, pay for, or participate in one. The subscription graphic and request to follow on Twitter are ordinary audience-engagement prompts; neither asks viewers for money or credentials. Taken together, the material is commentary on an allegation, not a direct offer or solicitation.
